```{r}
#| label: load packages
#| include: false

library(ggplot2)

```

First, we need to define the function

```{webr-r}

replicate_means_function <- function(rep, n, interval){
  df <- replicate(rep, mean(sample(interval, n, replace = TRUE)))
  
  return(hist(df))
  
}

```

Run this code to generate n random numbers between x and y. 

```{webr-r}

#interval [x:y] to draw random numbers from
interval <- c(1,10)

#amount of random numbers randomly drawn from interval 
n <- 15

#number of times this is repeated (incl. mean calculation)
rep <- 20


replicate_means_function(rep, n,interval)

```
